From Earth Wind and Fire · Price: you turn into objects only, and you can't attack in object form.

Theme Matter and Life

  • 1: 1 action: become a Small object. You can't move or attack; Perception DC = your stand DC to spot you; you get resistance to all damage equal to half your level while shaped. Or become a weapon, shield or tool in an adjacent ally's hand (1 action): it gets +2 circumstance to AC and +2 circumstance to damage for 1 minute while it holds you. While you're shaped or held, once per turn your stand can lunge out from beside you (1 action): a Strike, and the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{off-guard} against it.
  • 5: Become a Medium object; your resistance while shaped equals your level. Your stand's lunge deals one extra weapon damage die. Surge: leave object form with a free Strike by your stand against an adjacent creature, which is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{off-guard}.
  • 9: Your surge's free Strike deals one extra weapon damage die.
  • 13: Become a cart or small boat that up to four allies can ride; you move it at your Speed. As a living tool your damage bonus is +4. A creature your stand's lunge hits is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{off-guard} for 1 round.
  • 17: Become a Large object.

Effects @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-stand-class-archetype.stand-effects.Item.SEVLkSvCkR1OPJu8]{Effect: Object Form}

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
